subject: English Language
content: Reading: Analysis of a fiction text. Students must answer questions on a provided source, demonstrating skills in comprehension, language analysis, and structural analysis.

subject: English Language
content: List four things from a specified part of the source (e.g., lines 1-8). Assessment of close reading and identification of key details. [4 marks]

subject: English Language
content: Analyse how the writer uses language to describe a scene or event. Focus on words, phrases, language features, techniques, and sentence forms. [8 marks]

subject: English Language
content: Analyse how the writer structures the text to interest the reader. Focus on narrative focus, shifts in perspective, and structural features. [8 marks]

subject: English Language
content: Evaluate a student's statement about the text, supporting responses with references. Focus on interpretation, critical analysis, and textual evidence. [20 marks]

subject: English Language
content: Writing: Creative writing task. Students must write either a description based on a picture or a story based on a prompt (e.g., 'a day when technology stopped'). Assessment includes content, organisation, and technical accuracy. [40 marks]
